jlpt.name: davidluzgouveia/kanji-data (jlpt_new field)
jlpt.usedFor: N4/N3 kanji list grouping (jlpt_new, an unofficial community-maintained list; JLPT publishes no official kanji list post-2010 reform)
jlpt.license: MIT (repository); underlying JLPT grouping originally compiled by Jonathan Waller, tanos.co.uk/jlpt

kanji.name: KANJIDIC2 (via davidluzgouveia/kanji-data)
kanji.usedFor: character, stroke count, frequency rank, grade, English meanings, on/kun readings
kanji.license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group)

hanViet.name: Unicode Unihan Database (kVietnamese field)
hanViet.usedFor: Vietnamese Han-Viet reading(s) per character, used as a fallback when the CC-CEDICT source below has no entry
hanViet.license: Unicode, Inc. License Agreement (Unicode Data Files)

radical.name: KANJIDIC2 (classical radical number) + Unicode CJKRadicals.txt (radical number to character mapping)
radical.usedFor: radical.raw (classical radical number) and radical.character (the corresponding CJK unified ideograph); radical.meaningVi has no source and is left null
radical.license: KANJIDIC2: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (EDRDG); CJKRadicals.txt: Unicode, Inc. License Agreement

hanVietPrimary.name: CC-CEDICT augmented with Han-Viet readings (alienngator/zhongwen fork, data compiled by Lien Hoang from Thieu Chuu's 1942 Han Viet Tu Dien and the DTK Han Viet Tu Dien Trich Dan, used with permission per that repository)
hanVietPrimary.usedFor: primary Vietnamese Han-Viet reading(s) per character (better coverage than Unihan for common kanji); only the character-to-reading mapping was taken, not the Vietnamese/English gloss text
hanVietPrimary.license: CC-CEDICT base data is CC BY-SA 4.0 (MDBG/CC-CEDICT); the Han-Viet augmentation layer's licensing is not separately, formally declared by the fork beyond the permission note above — verify before commercial redistribution

meaningsViDraft.name: AI-translated draft (Claude), NOT a verified external dataset
meaningsViDraft.url: n/a -- generated for this project from this dataset's own meanings.en
meaningsViDraft.usedFor: meanings.viDraft only, an unverified starting point for human review; never written into the verified meanings.vi field

notes: JLPT publishes no official kanji list for N4/N3 post-2010; this dataset uses a widely-used community-compiled grouping. See README for details.

37 kanji have no entry in either the CC-CEDICT or Unihan Han-Viet sources (mostly Japan-only shinjitai forms with no matching Chinese-character-set entry) and were left with hanViet: [] rather than guessed.

meanings.vi (verified) is intentionally left empty for all entries: no verified open Kanji-to-Vietnamese dataset was available. meanings.viDraft holds an AI-translated (not human-verified) draft instead -- review before promoting into meanings.vi.
words, examples, and mnemonic are intentionally left empty: no verified open dataset was available for these fields in this build pass.
